versions.subject: Create cisco_configuration_file_exfiltration_attempts.yml
versions.detection: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count values(All_Changes.command) as commands min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Change.All_Changes where sourcetype="cisco:ios" AND ( (All_Changes.command="*copy*startup-config*tftp*") OR (All_Changes.command="*copy*running-config*tftp*") OR (All_Changes.command="*CONFIG_I: Configured from console*" AND All_Changes.command="*tftp*") ) by All_Changes.dvc All_Changes.user | `drop_dm_object_name("All_Changes")` | rename dvc as dest | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | `cisco_configuration_file_exfiltration_attempts_filter`
versions.spl: | tstats summariesonly=MACRO=summariesonly_config allow_old_summaries=MACRO=oldsummaries_config fillnull_value=MACRO=fillnull_config count values(All_Changes.command) as commands min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Change.All_Changes where sourcetype="cisco:ios" AND ( (All_Changes.command="*copy*startup-config*tftp*") OR (All_Changes.command="*copy*running-config*tftp*") OR (All_Changes.command="*CONFIG_I: Configured from console*" AND All_Changes.command="*tftp*") ) by All_Changes.dvc All_Changes.user | MACRO=drop_dm_object_name("All_Changes") | rename dvc as dest | convert timeformat="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S" ctime(firstTime) | convert timeformat="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S" ctime(lastTime) | MACRO=cisco_configuration_file_exfiltration_attempts_filter
